item.title: Palestinian Man Recounts Brutal Sexual Assault by Israeli Settlers
item.summary: The man said his attackers stripped him naked, beat him and zip-tied his genitalia, an account corroborated by family members and a rights activist who were also beaten.

item.title: Strikes Deliver Another Blow to Iran’s Domestic Energy Sites
item.summary: The attacks could worsen the severe electricity shortages that Iranians already face.

item.title: Iran Maintains Near-Total Internet Blackout Amid U.S.-Israeli Strikes
item.summary: As the war has stretched into its third week, the Iranian government has blocked internet access for most of its 92 million citizens.

item.title: U.S. Intelligence Saw No Change in Iran’s Missile Capabilities Before War
item.summary: On Wednesday, the director of national intelligence and C.I.A. director contradicted one of the justifications the Trump administration had given for its attacks on Iran.

item.title: A Lebanese Cafe on the Edge of Destruction
item.summary: Near the center of Beirut, one image captures the aftermath of an Israeli strike.

item.title: Iran Executes Swedish Citizen Accused of Spying
item.summary: The case indicates that more than two weeks into the war, Iran continues its prosecution of foreigners. Sweden said its citizen did not get a fair trial.

item.title: Energy Facilities Attacked in Iran and Qatar, Sending Prices Soaring
item.summary: The strikes on a gas field in Iran and an industrial complex in Qatar appeared to be some of the most significant attacks on energy sites since the U.S.-Israeli air war against Iran began.

item.title: Couple Killed in Cluster Bomb Attack Near Tel Aviv
item.summary: Neighbors told Israeli news media that their apartment building was hit soon after a siren sounded.

item.title: Israel Has Killed Esmaeil Khatib, Iran’s Intelligence Minister
item.summary: The Israeli military said on Wednesday that it had killed Esmaeil Khatib in an airstrike. Iran confirmed the killing.

item.title: Over 200 Ukrainian Experts in Middle East to Help Fight Drones, Zelensky Says
item.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that 11 countries in the region have asked for Kyiv’s assistance. Russia has launched such drones against Ukraine for years.
